title: Unramified Cohomology of Mixed-Type Classifying Spaces

proved_scope.groups: split semisimple, with finite central quotients explicitly retained

original_scope_qualification: OWR Question 2 does not restate characteristic zero, though the immediately preceding Theorem 2 does. This investigation does not settle the characteristic-p primary part.
partial_results: Only the central 2-primary quotient on A_(2r-1), B, C, D and E7 factors can contribute in characteristic zero.
A criterion for factoring the whole central subgroup gives valid product reductions; pairwise projection tests do not suffice.
An E7-to-D6+A1 detection argument preserves arbitrary mixed central identifications and reduces universal vanishing to arbitrary mixed classical groups.
Every central quotient of E7^a x Spin_12^b x SL_2^c has vanishing U in characteristic zero; arbitrary odd-center factors may be added.
An explicit degree-two quaternion lifting obstruction explains why independent-factor residue tests need not define torsors of (Spin_7 x Sp_6)/diag(mu_2).
remaining_gap: No general compatible degree-three invariant and residue analysis for coupled classical central 2-primary quotients; no nonzero globally unramified degree-three class.
test_example_status: The report does not determine U((Spin_7 x Sp_6)/diag(mu_2)) or assert that this individual example is open worldwide.
